d:
Asish Mohapatra, Founder of OfBusiness, on building a profitable unicorn in India's most overlooked industry.
He explains:
• How OfBusiness built high revenue, high profit, and fast growth simultaneously in a boring industry
• Why he believes the most boring industries hide the biggest business opportunities in India
• How to build a 1000 crore business without burning cash
• Why almost nobody builds for India's real economy and why that gap is the opportunity
• How OfBusiness makes money on every single transaction rather than chasing scale first
